caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure sculpted in a stylized manner, positioned on a square pedestal or base that is colored in shades of blue and brown. The figure wears a short blue shirt with silver decorative bands and a red drape or sash that crosses from the left shoulder across the torso. The lower garment is yellow and reaches to above the knees, with brown leggings and tan socks or leg wraps, and brown shoes. The figure has long, dark hair and wears a gray headband adorned with three yellow feathers that point upward. In the figure's right hand, there is a brown elliptical object, possibly a pouch or bag, while the left hand rests across the body, holding the edge of the red drape. The background is plain and light with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Indian
